about_the_game:
The world is being eroded by an evil magical force. The earth is full of horrible creatures that have been eroded. Humanity is forced into a dangerous situation of life and death. You need to assemble a strong team of adventurers, lead them to find the source of this evil magic, purify it, and save the human world.

Assemble A Great Adventure Team

You can choose your team members from 12 uniquely crafted heroes, each with their own combat style, abilities, and personality. Whether you prefer the brute strength of a seasoned warrior, the stealth and precision of a rogue, or the arcane mastery of a battle mage, there's a hero that fits your strategy.

Build your ideal squad by combining different roles—tanks, healers, damage dealers, and support—to face the challenges ahead. Every hero brings something different to the battlefield, and your choices will shape the course of your adventure.

Will you form a balanced team, or go all-in on your favorite playstyle?
The fate of your journey begins with who you choose.

Arm Your Team

Equip your heroes with powerful weapons, enchanted armor, and rare artifacts to give them the edge in battle. Each piece of gear brings unique effects that can change the flow of combat—whether through brute force, tactical control, or clever trickery.

From the mischievous Sheepwand, which transforms enemies into harmless sheep for a turn, to the Stunwall, a heavy shield capable of stunning foes upon impact, the right equipment can make all the difference. Want speed? The Haste Gloves grant rapid strikes and faster turns—perfect for agile rogues or spell-slinging mages.

Carefully mix and match gear to enhance your team’s synergy. Some items offer passive stat boosts, while others unlock active abilities you can deploy at just the right moment.

Will you forge a team of unstoppable juggernauts, elusive assassins, or cunning tacticians?
The battle begins long before the first blow is struck—arm wisely.

Engage in Intense Battles

Face off against ruthless enemies in fast-paced, tactical combat where every decision counts. Time your skills, manage cooldowns, and exploit enemy weaknesses to gain the upper hand. The battlefield is ever-changing—positioning, synergy, and timing are just as important as raw power.

Enemies won’t go down easily. They block, counter, unleash area attacks, and adapt to your strategies. Some battles will test your endurance; others will push your reflexes and wit to the limit.

Whether it’s a desperate last stand against a towering boss or a rapid exchange of spells and blades, every fight is a chance to prove your team’s strength—and your skill as a commander.

Victory is never given. It must be earned, blow by blow.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-750 / AMD® Phenom™ II X4 965
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GT 630 (2 GB) / AMD® Radeon™ HD 6670 (2 GB)
  • Storage: 512 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-3570/ AMD® FX-Series™ FX-8300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 650 (2 GB) / AMD® Radeon™ HD 7750 (2 GB)
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: A strategy game blending pinball and tower defense. Build your team through card draws, equip gear to enhance abilities, and arrange flexible formations. Face relentless enemy waves, grow stronger continuously, and break through challenges with your own combat style.
supported_languages: English, French, German, Japanese, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Traditional Chinese
